answer: Every identity carries a public pigment scalar: total attestation weight received. The chain caps the per-epoch delta of pigment by a function of identity age alone, so a fresh address earns at most what any newborn can. A clone farm pushing many fresh identities to the summit of eligibility in one wave shows identical pigment deltas - a fingerprint the on-ledger duplicate check burns. To desynchronize, each twin needs its own live attestation schedule: a separate signer held online for the full 6-hour epoch, per clone. Linear cost, no batch path.
